PART   I-A 
CENTRAL SECTION 
Orders  and  Notifications  (Other than those published in Part IV-B) 
under the Gujarat Local Boards, Village Panchayats, Municipal 
Boroughs, District Municipal, Primary Education and Local Fund Audit Acts. 
 
PANCHAYATS, RURAL HOUSING AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT 
NOTIFICATION 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, 8th July, 2021. 
GUJARAT PANCHAYATS ACT, 1993. 
No.KP/16/2021/PSR/1394/766/KH:-In exercise of the powers conferred by section 274 read with sub-section (5) and 
(6) of section 227 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993(Guj.18 of 1993), the Government of Gujarat hereby repeals the 
Gujarat District Panchayat Service Selection Committee (Functions) Rules, 1998 as follows, namely:-  
1. These rules may be called the Gujarat District Panchayat Service Selection Committee (Functions) (Repeal) Rules, 2021.  
2. The Gujarat District Panchayat Service Selection Committee (Functions) Rules, 1998, issued under the Government 
Notification, Panchayats, Rural Housing and Rural Development Department, No.KP/39/1998/PSR/1294/766/10-3-D, 
dated the 7th July, 1998 are hereby repealed:  
Provided that such repeal shall not affect the thing done or any action taken under the rules so repealed:  
Provided however that all the advertisements for recruitment published by the District Panchayat Service 
Selection Committees of all 33 districts, in which competitive examination is not held, shall stand withdrawn and 
cancelled. 
By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujarat,  
JAYDEEP DVIVEDI, 
Joint Secretary to Government. 
----------------
